objective: Supply the exact remaining Tool Discovery interface fact without self-attested completeness and repair Dynamic V3's cheaper-undiscovered-route counterexample by making the Brain-owned discovery registry the invocation authority and materializing that whole authority before V3 may probe or select.

frozen_scope_binding.same_scope_rule: Brain and Opus 5.5 must be evaluated on the same frozen task population/harness/tool authority unless an absolute/theoretical ceiling is the proof mode.
frozen_scope_binding.target_preservation: Unknown identities remain unknown to the policy until the authority snapshot is materialized; hidden capabilities remain hidden until safe probe receipts. Registry replacement advances the epoch and forces restart.
frozen_scope_binding.scope_nonclaim: No claim is made that one frozen tool-authority epoch enumerates every tool on the global Internet or every future ecosystem.

v3_counterexample.fact: Raw Dynamic V3 can SELECT a cost-10 visible sufficient tool while an unqueried discovery source may contain a cost-1 sufficient tool.
v3_counterexample.consequence: The prior conditional refinement must not be interpreted as proving global least-cost selection for arbitrary incomplete visible sets, even when a complete discovery source exists.
v3_counterexample.repair: V2 materializes the exact complete owned tool authority into visible_tools before Dynamic V3 is called, so no authority member remains undiscovered at selection time.

interface_contract_v1_property_witnesses.DISCOVERY_RECEIPT_IDENTIFIES_QUERIED_SOU: discover() emits source_id BRAIN_OWNED_TOOL_AUTHORITY_V2 and the current epoch.
interface_contract_v1_property_witnesses.DISCOVERY_RESULTS_MONOTONICALLY_ADD_VISI: The single current-epoch discovery result materializes the full registry in one step; no within-epoch deletion or hidden member exists.

universal_route_argument: For any finite frozen tool-authority registry R, discover(R) returns exactly R while hiding capability truth.
The adapter materializes all of R before Dynamic V3 decides, eliminating identity incompleteness at selection time.

Dynamic V3 orders the complete admissible visible set by cost then tool id, probes the first unresolved required capability of the cheapest not-disproved tool, selects only after all required capabilities have current positive evidence, and skips a tool only after current negative evidence.
Therefore within R, any SELECT is the globally least-cost currently verified sufficient route; if no route survives current evidence, escalation is fail-closed.
Authority replacement changes epoch, so stale identity or capability evidence cannot silently cross ecosystems.
